title: Data Ingestion Pipeline -- From Lake to Warehouse to Mart
description: Sequence a data lake, ETL, warehouse and marts, and look inside the warehouse's star schema.
creator: Systems Thinking in the Age of AI
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Systems Thinking in the Age of AI
Data Management and Governance

educational.learningObjective: Given a data pipeline from raw source to analytical storage, the learner will sequence a data lake, an ETL process, a central data warehouse, a data mart and a star schema in their correct order and explain what each stage adds.
prerequisites: Has heard the terms ETL or data warehouse
learningOutcomes: Sequence the five pipeline stages correctly
State what each stage adds that the previous one could not
Distinguish a fact table from a dimension table in a star schema
educational.assessmentOpportunity: Ask learners to name the stage where two departments' definitions of 'customer' get reconciled, and to explain what happens if that stage is skipped.

pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click-to-explain pipeline with a nested detail level and an animation
pedagogical.instructionalStrategy: Sequencing with a justification for each position
pedagogical.feedbackType: An explanation panel per stage plus a second-level panel for the star schema
misconceptionsAddressed: That a data lake and a data warehouse are alternatives rather than stages
That a data mart is an independent database
discussionQuestions: Why is a mart loaded independently of the warehouse a silo in disguise?
What is the real cost of a data lake with no governance?
Where in this pipeline would you put a data steward?
